title: Predicting adverse birth outcome among childbearing women in Sub-Saharan Africa: employing innovative machine learning techniques.
summary: Random forest ranked best for adverse birth-outcome prediction in 139,659 women across 26 Sub-Saharan African countries; reported outcome prevalence and risk features remain DHS-derived associations.
